title: Basic Crystal Grid
text: Holds three spell crystals. Equip it to supply the staff spell chain. In a Mana Engine it provides a 1.2x output multiplier.
R edits the first equipped grid, or only the first inventory grid if none is equipped. Inventory grids are editable but grant no bonuses, spell wheel or casting.
Only the first equipped grid supplies bonuses and the spell chain. Removing it promotes the next equipped grid. The spell wheel shows both shape and keywords.
